description: Configure the camera settings for 'Parking Lot Camera' in the Nx Witness VMS system via the Web Admin at https://localhost:7001/static/index.html (credentials: admin/Admin1234!). Navigate to the Cameras section, select the 'Parking Lot Camera', and in the Image section change the Rotation setting from '0°' to '90°'. Then enable audio for this camera by checking the 'Enable Audio' checkbox in the Audio section. Click Save (or Apply) to confirm the changes.
